result.summary: The image shows a signalized residential intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and marked crosswalks. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and the wide, open geometry of the intersection lacks physical traffic calming measures to protect pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, making them less visible to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground and middle ground roadways

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island or curb extensions to shorten the exposure time.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the crosswalk markings with high-visibility thermoplastic to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: This residential street features continuous sidewalks but lacks basic crossing infrastructure at the intersection, such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps. Pedestrians must navigate between parked cars and rely on vehicle traffic signals, which increases exposure and risk.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, making pedestrian crossing points less predictable for drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of sloped transitions at the corner creates a barrier for people with mobility devices or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the foreground

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars close to the intersection corner block the view between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb to the right of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the corner to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light pole.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, though the markings are significantly faded. The presence of parked cars near the corner and the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals increase risk for those crossing.
